title: Urban Air Adventure Park
specs: Attractions include trampolines, climbing walls, go-karts, laser tag, ropes course, zipline, and more
Parent ticket required with purchase of child's pass; must match child's attraction level
Kids Birthday Parties available with packages and online booking
includes: Unlimited play during regular business hours
Go-Karts included with Unlimited Play+ and Membership
One pair of Urban Air Socks included with membership initial visit
blurb: Urban Air is an indoor trampoline and adventure park where families can jump, climb, race, soar, and play together. The park offers an All Day Play Promise with no time limits on play. Attractions include trampolines, climbing walls, go-karts, laser tag, and more.
extraNote: If park reaches capacity and guest leaves, they receive a complimentary return pass valid for 30 days at same park · Return passes are non-transferable, no cash value, exclude add-ons · Standard park rules and waiver requirements apply · Prices do not include tax · Offers and pricing not valid for parties, groups, or special events
